verdict.rationale: The only direct signals are a marketing anecdote about dispatching 50 agents across 500 open issues and a terminal action to close all other sessions at once. A public REST API/OpenAPI spec and a CLI for operating an instance could support scripted bulk work, but none of the evidence documents bulk operations. Missing for 10: documented in-app bulk select/act on conversations, agents, files or tasks; documented batch endpoints or CLI batch commands; any hands-on or independent corroboration of the parallel-agent bulk processing claim.
